lines.say: Your city now sells a twenty fifth hour. Ninety nine dollars a day.
You buy it. While everyone else sleeps, you get an extra hour. You feel unstoppable.
Then everyone buys it. Your extra hour is normal again.
So they sell hour twenty six. Then twenty seven.
Now the day has thirty hours. Your boss pays you for twenty four.
Would you buy the extra hour? Write it in the comments.
